page.overview:
Who is Bolig Avati?

Bolig Avati was the Lead Administator of the Ixian Technocrat Council. He, and the other members of the Technocrat Council, conspired against Earl Rhombur Vernius, so the Council could wretch control of the planet from the Royal Family.

Bolig Avati and the other Ixian advisors repeatedly tried to assassinate Earl Rhombur Vernius, the ruler of the Royal Family of Ix, by staging accidents, so the Technocrat Council of Ix could rule the planet.

Bolig Avati attended a meeting at the Landsraad Hall of Oratory, with other representatives of factions chosen by the newly elected Padishah Emperor Paul Atreides. Durinng the meeting, Paul proposed an alliance between the Atreides Empire and the factions, in which the Imperium would protect their holdings. Avati asked Paul whether they would have to worship Paul, should they agree to their alliance. More factions than Paul initially believed were hesitant toward an alliance with the Atreides and the meeting ended without a contract signed.

When Earl Rhombur Vernius of Ix survived an assassination attempt, albeit damaged, the Ixian advisors consistently bothered Vernius, threatening to disrupt his rule. In a fit of anger, the cybernetically enhanced Vernius struck Avati, sending him flying across the room. His fellow advisers helped him up and retreated to the House frigate.
